literal_meaning: to make cool / to become cool
figurative_meaning_en: to soothe, to calm or appease anger
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার রাগ ঠাণ্ডা করার জন্য আমি একটি উপহার দিলাম।
একটু সময় দাও, মন ঠাণ্ডা হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: I gave him a gift to cool down his anger.
Give it some time, and your mind will calm down.
note: The idiom draws from the physical sensation of cooling to metaphorically describe emotional relief, common in Bengali expressive language.
